hypothesis: Request223 is being diluted by structurally bad pullbacks. A causal gate decided once at pullback onset should identify which pullbacks are worth handing to the adaptive controller.

eligibility_target.definition: BASE return at first causal reacceleration or observed 30-minute cap minus EXIT-now at pullback onset.

onset_geometry: size of immediately preceding up move
one-minute attention, rank, volume, transaction and active-second changes
current one-second momentum, VWAP position, burst, imbalance, efficiency and volatility proxies
change in selected one-second features since entry

threshold_selection.objective: maximum day-balanced local uplift of the geometry-gated Request223 controller

policy.eligible: hand the pullback to frozen Request223 adaptive redecision logic

comparators: EXIT at pullback onset with local uplift zero
forbidden: changing geometry features or threshold quantiles after seeing Request178 results
using future terminal price or future timing as model input
claiming a local pullback gate is a validated full trading strategy
next_if_pass: Freeze pullback eligibility and adaptive management, then build the reacceleration continuation/exit handoff and replay full Request208-entry trajectories.
next_if_fail: Move eligibility one observed event into the pullback and test causal early-shape gating instead of onset-only geometry.
